notes: Operating EBIT is analytically derived, not a reported operating-income subtotal. Transaction costs and loss on assets held for sale remain in EBIT. Interest and Other nonoperating income/expense are excluded.
Cash capex and proceeds follow the cash-flow statement, not accrual-basis equipment sales revenue. Capex is expressed as a positive outflow.

H&E results consolidated from June 2, 2025. FY2025 contains a partial period; current TTM Oct 1 2025-Sep 30 2026 contains 12 months of acquired operations. Growth across FY2024/FY2025 is acquisition-distorted.

Comparable TTM2025Q3 spans October 1 2024-September 30 2025 and includes only about four months of H&E from June 2, 2025. Current TTM includes twelve months, so TTM growth and cash conversion are not like-for-like.
FY2024 includes $194m assets-held-for-sale loss; FY2025 includes $48m. No normalization applied.
Quarter cash flow observations derive from cumulative YTD differences; Q4 uses full year less nine months. Rounded reported amounts create rounding limits.
